lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Zn2Sb2 (Mg6ZnSb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg centers with 11- and 12-neighbor coordination, including a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Sb adopts a 9-neighbor environment and Zn shows 9 neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Mg 11- and 12-vertex polyhedra, plus corner, edge, and face contacts between Mg and Sb or Zn polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites.
